questions_and_answers.question_text: What does kuàng mean, and what does -qū mean?
What is the literal meaning of jīnshǔ?
What are the two meanings of niándài?
What is the difference between jīqì and jīxiè?
Give the Chinese for "machine worker" and "machine industry."
Write the Chinese for "Is this made of metal?"
Which of jīqì and jīxiè refers to individual machines?

articles.text:
3. A: Zhèige kuàngqūde jīnshǔ gōngyè When did the metal industry in this
      shi shénme shíhou kāishǐ       mining area begin?
      yǒude?
   B: Bāshí niándài. Jīxiè gōngyè  In the eighties. There wasn't a machine
      yě shi bāshí niándài cái       industry until the eighties, either.
      yǒude.

Notes on No. 3

kuàngqū: "mining area/region." KUÀNG is the word for "mine," as in méikuàng, "coal mine." -QŪ means "area," "region," as in dìqū, "region"; jiāoqū, "suburbs"; and shìqū, "urban area."

jīnshǔ: "metal," literally, "metal-category"

Zhèi shi jīnshǔde ma?            Is this (made of) metal?
Xiànzài wǒmen zuò zhèizhǒng      Now we no longer make this kind of thing
dōngxi bú yòng jīnshǔ, dōu       out of metal, we make it out of paper.
yòng zhǐ le.

niándài: This has TWO meanings:
  (1) (as used in 3B) "A DECADE OF A CENTURY," e.g., èrshí niándài, "the twenties";
  (2) "period," "era."

Zhèige gùshi xiěde shi shénme    What period is this story about?
niándàide shì?
Zhèipíng jiù shi shénme          What vintage is this wine?
niándàide?

jīxiè: "machine," "machinery," "mechanical." Also pronounced jīxie.

JĪQÌ, "machine," which you learned in Unit 3, is DIFFERENT from JĪXIÈ:
  — JĪQÌ refers to INDIVIDUAL machines. It virtually always translates as "machine(s)."
  — JĪXIÈ is machines IN GENERAL — MACHINERY. It may translate as "machine" in certain phrases, like jīxiè gōngrén, "machine worker," and jīxiè gōngyè, "machine industry."

Wǒmen zhèlide shēngchǎn zhǔyào   Most of our production here is by
kào jīxiè.                       machine.
